newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Copene, Petrobras may build $800mln refinery - paper.
newsitem.headline: Copene, Petrobras may build $800mln refinery - paper.

text.p: Copene Petroquimica do Nordeste and state oil firm Petrobras will form a group to study the viability of building an $800 million refinery in northeastern Brazil, a local newspaper said.

Leading financial daily Gazeta Mercantil said the plant to be build near Salvador in Bahia state would produce naptha and fuel oil and would be the first oil refinery built in Brazil with the participation of private capital.
The two firms are expected to sign a letter of intent on Friday and begin the study next week, it said.
Gazeta said Copene, which supplies raw material to the Camacari petrochemical complex, has been studying the project on its own with an eye toward becoming self-sufficient in naptha.
The paper said the firm now must import or buy from other parts of Brazil most of the naptha it consumes, which totalled 3.5 million tonnes last year.
